strings.en: It begins...
...A new life.
It ends...
...The land of beginnings.
Your...
Then we'll go ahead and join the robots that went down to Earth first.
Understood.
Once the Nadesico's adjustments are done, we'll head your way!
But... the Nadesico's computer...
It's Omoikane. ...Oh, that's its name. The computer's...
Allow me to explain.
In ancient Japanese myth, when Amaterasu hid in the Ama-no-Iwato,
it's the name of the thoughtful god who devised a way to lure her out.
Huh... I was on the Nadesico and even I didn't know that.
I see. That's a fine name.
...Thanks.
This Omoikane... the Nadesico's control computer...
Have you found the cause of its malfunction?
Yes, but fixing it looks like it'll take time...
Huh? Erina!?
I see. We can't take our time either. We're heading out.
R-Right! Please be careful.
...Thank you for your concern.
Right. As soon as they finish the night camouflage paint on the Billbine,
we'll head right out.
...Take care.
The Elshank and Gran Garan have launched.
Erina, we still don't know what made Omoikane malfunction...
Silly, saying that was the best move in that situation!
Right, right. The Nadesico still can't move either way.
No point telling them bad news, is there?
Huh... For a helmsman and a pilot, you two sure are good negotiators.
W-Well, I did get an elite education, you know.
That's just common sense for any working adult.
Tch. Guess we just had a bad upbringing.
Don't sulk, don't sulk.
Common sense... common cents... the small change of ordinary minds...
Too much of a stretch. Puns that obscure aren't worth it.
Captain Quattro seemed to realize it was just a white lie, but...
Hoshino. Truthfully, have we got no leads at all?
Everyone managed to protect us, but... if it's like that every time
from here on, we won't stand a chance...
Yeah. One lone ship standing up to the whole Federation!
Sure, that gets my blood pumping... but I'd rather not be the villain.
I'll tell you now, that was no maintenance problem.
What do you think? Ruri, Inez...
Well, Ruri knows Omoikane better than anyone...
I already know the reason. But as for treatment...
That's our Ruri! So, what's the cause? And...
Treatment...?
Omoikane is stressed out.
Huh...?
Stressed... out...?
This... looks like it's going to be troublesome...
